name: codex-auto-retry
description: Codex Stop hook plugin that retries transient high-demand, rate-limit, server, and network failures.

interface.longDescription: Codex Auto Retry watches Stop hook payloads for high demand, 429, 5xx, temporary provider errors, interrupted streams, and network failures, then asks Codex to retry with bounded exponential backoff.
defaultPrompt: Explain how Codex Auto Retry decides whether to retry
Show Codex Auto Retry configuration options
